review.note: Windows x64 counterpart of release/source-inventory.json. The complete project source is public at the repository above and every release is tagged v<version>; the release packager also ships a sources tarball, NOTICES and this resolved inventory next to each installer. This block does not gate a release. The items below are open review points about third-party component materials, kept for follow-up.
open_items: No whole-app binary/static dependency closure review or responsible release approval exists for the Windows installer.

The windows-x64 obs-deps 2026-08-26 bundle (FFmpeg with GPL components, x264, librist, srt, mbedTLS, etc.) and its exact sources/build configuration are not archived here; FFmpeg GPLv3 whole-combination terms are open as on macOS.
Qt 6 (obs-deps-qt6 2026-08-26 x64) exact module sources, notices and relinking materials are incomplete.
WinSparkle 0.9.4 is shipped as the upstream prebuilt DLL; its tag archive excludes the bundled third-party submodules (expat and others), whose notices are carried by COPYING.expat only.
Vendor-signed redistributables in the program tree (MSVC runtime, NVIDIA/AMD/Intel encoder interfaces, Blackmagic DeckLink API) need redistribution review.
Review modification notices/dates, build/install instructions and codec/patent obligations for the Windows payload.

excluded_submodules.reason: Built into win-dshow; its source and the nested capture-device-support source ship as the libdshowcapture and capture-device-support component archives rather than as a checkout
Browser source is disabled in the Pixelview Windows build (ENABLE_BROWSER=OFF); submodule not built
obs-websocket is disabled in the Pixelview Windows build (ENABLE_WEBSOCKET=OFF); submodule not built
